Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1402
Claimant:
Samantha Fowler
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
2024-02-06
Claim received for a rear-end collision in which our insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a traffic
signal. The claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2024-02-08
Reviewed the police report, which records the claimant as a passenger in the vehicle at the time of impact. The report
and the statements of two independent witnesses are consistent with the account given at first notice.
2024-02-23
Spoke with the at-fault driver, who acknowledged responsibility and described the impact in the same terms as the
witnesses. Photographs taken at the scene show rear-end damage that is largely in line with the reported force of
impact.
2024-03-31
Received the claimant's injury notice through counsel, describing neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash.
The mechanism of injury appears well matched to the kind and force of the crash.
2024-04-01
Confirmed with the policy records that the driver involved is listed as a named driver on the policy, and that the policy
was in force at the time of loss with no coverage gap.
2024-04-23
Checked the vehicle history and prior claims database. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on file, and nothing
suggests the damage predates the policy's effective date.
2024-05-01
Recorded the claimant's account in a recorded call with counsel present. The details matched the earlier description
given at first notice, and the claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far.
2024-05-05
Reviewed the medical records provided through counsel. The treatment followed a usual course of care and tapered
as the claimant's condition improved. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the records or from the
claimant's history.
2024-05-27
Obtained the repair estimate and the appraiser's inspection notes. The damage is mostly consistent with the
described impact, and the repair scope has been reviewed line by line with the appraiser.
2024-06-06
Followed up with the treating provider's office to confirm billing and treatment dates. The billing lines match the
records and the expected course of treatment for this type of injury.
2024-07-12
Spoke with counsel to review the status of treatment and the demand package. Counsel confirmed the claimant's
recovery is progressing and that treatment is winding down.
2024-07-21
Updated the reserve to reflect the current treatment status and repair scope. The file is on track for evaluation, with
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
